actions.add_comment_to_conversation.desc: Add an internal comment/note to a conversation in Respond.io.
actions.add_comment_to_conversation.prop: The internal comment to add (max 1000 characters). You can mention users with {{@user.ID}} format where ID is the user ID.
actions.add_tag_to_contact.description: Add one or multiple tags to a contact in Respond.io.
actions.add_tag_to_contact.props.tags.de: Tags to add to the contact (minimum 1, maximum 10 tags).
Assign or unassign a conversation to/from a team member in Respond.io.
Select the user to assign the conversation to. Leave empty to unassign.
actions.create_contact.description: Create a new contact record in Respond.io.
actions.create_contact.props.customField: Add custom fields for the contact.
actions.create_contact.props.email.descr: The email address of the contact.
Must be a unique identifier for the new contact. Use format: `email:user@example.com` or `phone:+60123456789`.
actions.create_contact.props.phone.descr: The phone number of the contact (in E.164 format).
A direct URL to the contact's profile picture.
actions.create_or_update_contact.descrip: Create a new contact or update an existing one by email, phone, or ID.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.c: Add custom fields for the contact.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.e: The email address of the contact.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.i: Identifier for the contact. Use format: `id:123`, `email:user@example.com`, or `phone:+60123456789`. If contact exists, it will be updated; if not, a new one will be created.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.p: The phone number of the contact (in E.164 format).
A direct URL to the contact's profile picture.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from Respond.io.
actions.find_contact.description: Search for contacts by name, email, or phone number in Respond.io.
actions.find_contact.props.cursorId.desc: Contact ID to start from for pagination. Optional.
actions.find_contact.props.limit.descrip: Number of contacts to return (1-99). Default is 10.
actions.find_contact.props.search.descri: The value to search for (e.g., email address, phone number, or name).
actions.open_conversation.description: Mark a conversation as open in Respond.io.
auth.description:
Please follow these steps to get your Respond.io API token:
  
  1. Log in to your Respond.io account.
  2. In the left sidebar, navigate to Settings.
  3. Under Workspace Settings, click on Integrations.
  4. Locate and click on the Developer API option.
  5. Within the Developer API section, find your API key or generate a new one if needed.
triggers.contact_tag_updated.description: Triggers when a tag is added or removed from a contact in Respond.io.
triggers.contact_tag_updated.props.webho:
To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Respond.io account:

			1. Login to your Respond.io account.
			2. Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks.
			3. Click on "Add Webhook" or "Create New Webhook".
			4. Add the following URL in the **Webhook URL** field:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			5. Select **contact.tag.updated** from the event types.
			6. Click Save to create the webhook.
